# Gas

Supplied by Larkfield Energy since 1 July 2026. Larkfield Energy supply both gas and
electricity nationally, so documents from them name the subject as well as the
issuer.

## Account

- Account number: LE-5510934
- MPRN: 8841200733
- Meter serial: G4K9910273

## Tariff and renewals

Two renewals so far, both handled by letter rather than online. The first
renewal in 2025 held the unit rate; the second raised it by 1.8p. Future
renewals should be diarised six weeks ahead, because the renewal window closes
without warning and the out-of-contract rate is punitive.

- Unit rate 6.14p per kWh, standing charge 31.43p per day
- Renewal due 1 July 2027
